title: Spex Workspace Config
description: Workspace configuration (spex.yaml): the project and the workspace repositories that spex manages together.

description.description: Optional summary of what the project is and does.

repositories.description: Workspace repositories that spex manages for this project.

description.description: Optional summary of what the repository is and does.

path.description: Path to the repository, relative to the spex directory.

tech-specs.description: TECH spec IDs that apply to this repository.

checks_additional.description: Full checks that run for this repository in addition to the checks it inherits from its tech-specs. Each entry is a complete check plus the `spec` it belongs to (one of the repository's tech-specs). Script paths resolve under the repository directory.

checks_override.description: Partial patches applied to inherited checks. Each entry names the inherited check by `spec` + `name`; any other field present overrides that field, and the merged check runs instead of the inherited one. Set `disable: true` to turn the inherited check off entirely. When the override sets `script`, the path resolves under the repository directory; otherwise the inherited spex script is reused.

check_override.description: A partial patch for an inherited check. `spec` + `name` identify the target; every other field overrides the inherited check when present.

spec.description: Tech spec ID of the inherited check to override. Must be one of the repository's tech-specs.

name.description: Name of the inherited check to override.

disable.description: When `true`, the inherited check is disabled entirely and never runs. Other override fields are ignored.

pattern.description: Overrides the inherited check's regexp or glob pattern.

negate.description: Overrides the inherited check's negate flag.

script.description: Overrides the inherited check's script filename. When set, it resolves at `scripts/<spec-id>/<script>` under the repository directory.

run.description: Overrides the inherited script check's invocation granularity.

include.description: Overrides the inherited check's include globs.

exclude.description: Overrides the inherited check's exclude globs.
